title: Design a Chat System
interviewPrompt: For today's Software Engineer interview, design a chat system like WhatsApp.

beats.interviewer: For today's Software Engineer interview, design a chat system like WhatsApp.
beats.interviewee: Complete online path first: sender WebSocket to a chat server, server routes to the recipient's open socket. Works when both are online on one box.
beats.show: Naive complete online: Sender → Chat Server → Recipient.

beats.interviewer: So where's the actual hard part?
beats.interviewee: Same three-box system under pressure: recipient is offline half the time, and one server cannot hold every socket. We need routing and durability next.
beats.show: Same complete online path. Offline + multi-server are the gaps.

beats.interviewee: Full system now: persist first, presence map in Redis for which server holds the socket, online push to B, offline write to an inbox queue and deliver on reconnect.
beats.show: Complete: persist, presence, online push, offline inbox.

beats.interviewee: Same complete fan-out shape. Small groups: fan each message into member inboxes. Huge groups: store once, pull on read. Ordering and offline delivery stay the hard parts, not the socket.
beats.show: Same full system. Group = fan-out vs pull-on-read.
